name: block-insure-local-workflow
description: Local orchestration and end-to-end verification for Block-Insure

scripts.setup:local: npm --prefix backEnd run reset:local && npm --prefix contracts run fund:accounts:local && npm --prefix contracts run deploy:local && npm --prefix backEnd run grant:roles && npm --prefix backEnd run fund:local && npm --prefix backEnd run push:merkle && npm --prefix backEnd run verify:clean
